name: Chicken & rice power bowl
steps: Cook rice per package instructions (~15 min).
Slice chicken breast horizontally into 2 thinner pieces, season with salt, pepper, paprika.
Heat half the oil in a pan, sear chicken 4 min per side. Rest 2 min, slice.
Steam or microwave broccoli with a splash of water, 4 min.
Plate rice, broccoli, chicken. Drizzle remaining oil, lemon, minced raw garlic.
